caption: The worked example step by step: 90° about z gives the half angle 45° and the quaternion (0.7071, 0, 0, 0.7071). Rotating (1, 0, 0) lands on (0, 1, 0), and the matrix entry m₀₀ = 0 agrees with the zero x.

spec.title: 90° about z: quaternion to matrix
spec.aria: Flowchart of the worked example: 90 degrees about z gives half angle 45 degrees and unit quaternion (0.7071, 0, 0, 0.7071), two cross products rotate point (1, 0, 0) to (0, 1, 0), and matrix entry m00 = 1 − 2(y² + z²) = 0 matches.
